title: Data Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite builds best-in-class software that accelerates commercialization and innovation by connecting scientific research with industry partners. We support universities, national labs, and research hospitals worldwide with tools that simplify complex science and identify real partnership opportunities.

Role Overview

The Data Engineer will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems that integrate diverse datasets. This role includes deploying AI and machine learning solutions to enhance insights, manage complex data relationships, and drive actionable intelligence for FirstIgnite’s platform. You will mentor and manage a team of data engineers while working cross-functionally to innovate and deliver impactful AI‑driven solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM‑based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI / ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI / CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.

Requirements

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS data services (Glue / PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI‑enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade‑offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI / CD practices.
  • Exposure to data science / ML libraries (Pandas, Scikit‑learn, PyTorch) and managed ML platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI) is a plus.
  • Excellent problem‑solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross‑functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM‑based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.

title: Virtual Assistant Team Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job Description

Talent Manager (Independent Contractor) Must send resume in English

Overview

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities

Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and elevate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.

Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)

Technical Requirements

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software

Personal Attributes

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals

Note

This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

Requirements

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer

About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.

About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

In this role, you will monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications. Relational Database experience with SQL, MySQL, Oracle SQL, or PL/SQL experience is preferred. Salesforce System Analyst

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce System Analyst with 5 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is critical in driving the optimization and enhancement of our Sales Cloud platform, ensuring seamless Salesforce migration, effective Salesforce administration, and robust system configuration and implementation. The Salesforce System Analyst will play a pivotal role in aligning our CRM capabilities with business goals, improving sales processes, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making across the organization.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage end‑to‑end Salesforce migration projects, ensuring data integrity and minimal disruption to business operations.
  • Perform comprehensive Salesforce administration tasks, including user management, security settings, and system maintenance.
  • Configure and customize Sales Cloud features to meet evolving business requirements, including workflows, validation rules, and custom objects.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate them into scalable technical solutions within Salesforce.
  • Drive the implementation of new Salesforce functionalities and third‑party integrations to enhance system capabilities.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to maintain optimal platform efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation related to system configurations, processes, and best practices.

  • Stay updated on the latest Salesforce releases and industry trends to recommend innovative solutions.

  • 5 to 10 years of proven experience as a Salesforce System Analyst or similar role.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201), Salesforce Platform App Builder, or relevant advanced certifications are highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of Sales Cloud functionalities and CRM best practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in Salesforce migration, administration, configuration, and implementation projects.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams and manage multiple priorities.

Tools and Technologies

  • Salesforce Administration tools and features
  • Salesforce Migration tools (e.g., Data Loader, Salesforce DX)
  • Salesforce Configuration and Customization tools (Workflows, Process Builder, Flow Builder)
  • Integration tools (e.g., MuleSoft, REST/SOAP APIs)
  • Reporting and Dashboard tools within Salesforce
  • Version control and collaboration platforms (e.g., Git, Jira)

Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)

Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)

Location: LATAM

Duration: 6-12 months

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.
  • Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.
  • Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards.
  • Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.
  • Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation.
  • Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.
  • Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud.
  • Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications.
  • Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem‑solving skills.

Secondary (Good‑to‑Have)

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Our Client is hiring a designer to support a high-output marketing team. This is not a brand-from-scratch role. The design system exists, and the job is to execute consistently, extend it intelligently, and keep things moving without hand-holding.

You’ll work directly with Marketing, with guidance from the Creative Director. Most of what you produce will show up in demand gen campaigns, event programs, and product marketing. It needs to look sharp, ship fast, and hold up across channels.

What you’ll do

  • You’ll be responsible for a wide range of design work tied directly to pipeline-driving campaigns
  • Create graphics for social, paid campaigns, email, and web
  • Design and iterate on landing pages in Webflow
  • Produce visual assets for webinars, virtual events, and campaigns
  • Design print collateral and occasional physical assets (including SWAG)
  • Create GIFs, motion elements, and lightweight animations
  • Edit video for social distribution and website use
  • Support ongoing campaign launches with fast-turn creative
  • This is a volume role, and you’ll be expected to make good decisions quickly and maintain quality under pace.

What matters in this role

  • You can operate inside an existing brand system without needing constant direction
  • You understand how design actually shows up in B2B marketing, not just how it looks in a portfolio
  • You’re comfortable moving between formats. Static, motion, web, video. No one is handing off perfect briefs every time
  • You have strong judgment about what’s “good enough to ship” vs what needs refinement
  • You can manage your own workflow and keep projects moving without bottlenecks

Requirements

  • 4+ years in a design role, ideally supporting marketing or growth teams
  • Strong portfolio that shows real campaign work, not just one-off visuals
  • Experience designing in Webflow (not just Figma concepts)
  • Experience with motion design and basic animation (GIFs, short-form video)
  • Video editing experience for social and web content
  • Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

Context for the work

Our client sells to B2B marketing teams running webinars and virtual events as part of pipeline generation. That means the creative you produce will be tied directly to:

  • Driving registrations and product demos
  • Reinforcing brand credibility with senior marketing leaders

The output needs to feel polished, but it has to perform, not just look good.

What this is not

  • Not a pure brand exploration role
  • Not a pixel-perfect, weeks-per-project environment
  • Not isolated design work handed over a wall

You’ll be in the middle of campaigns, working closely with marketers who are moving fast and expect the same from you.

If that sounds like your kind of environment, this will be a good fit.

  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.

O que oferecemos

Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.

Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.

Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.

Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência.

Operations & Logistics Manager (E-commerce)

We’re looking for an Operations & Logistics Manager who can keep products moving smoothly—from supplier to customer—without drama. If you love building systems, solving shipping puzzles, and making fulfillment faster + cheaper, you’ll fit right in.

Location: Remote/Brazil | Full-time

What you’ll own

You’ll be the glue between supply chain, fulfillment, and customer experience. Key responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Manage end-to-end logistics: inbound freight, warehousing/3PL, outbound shipping
  • Own relationships and performance with 3PLs, carriers, freight forwarders, and vendors
  • Improve shipping speed, accuracy, and cost (fewer “where is my package?” moments)
  • Oversee inventory flow and replenishment planning to prevent stockouts/overstock
  • Create and maintain SOPs for receiving, picking/packing, returns, and exception handling
  • Build dashboards for key KPIs (OTIF, shipping cost per order, fulfillment accuracy, returns rate)
  • Lead continuous improvement projects (process, tools, automation, packaging optimization)
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with CX, marketing, finance, and product team on launches and promos

What success looks like (90 days)

  • 3PL/carrier performance clearly tracked and improved
  • Fewer shipping issues and faster resolution time
  • Clear SOPs and smoother handoffs between teams
  • Inventory is more predictable (less “oops we ran out”)
  • Shipping costs are controlled while service levels stay strong

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years in logistics/operations (bonus: DTC e-commerce, Shopify, Amazon, or retail)
  • Strong vendor management skills (hold partners accountable politely but firmly)
  • Solid understanding of shipping and freight (domestic and/or international)
  • Comfortable with data and spreadsheets (measure stuff, not just feel)Organized, proactive, and calm when things go sideways
  • Process builder: document, improve, and automate—not just do the work

Tools you may use (nice to have)

Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, NetSuite/QuickBooks, ShipStation/ShipBob, 3PL portals, Asana/ClickUp, Airtable, Google Sheets/Excel, Zapier/Make

Why join us

We’re growing fast and need someone who can help us scale without breaking fulfillment. You’ll have real ownership, a direct impact on profitability and customer experience, and a team that moves quickly.

How to apply

Send your resume and a short note answering:

  • What’s one logistics or fulfillment process you improved, and what changed?
  • What systems/3PLs/carriers have you worked with?

Estamos em plena expansão, com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. Buscamos um Builder para transformar nosso produto atual em uma plataforma de escala global.

Aqui, autonomia, responsabilidade e protagonismo são nossa vivência diária. Não buscamos pessoas prontas; não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.

Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico: da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.

Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência :

  • O Agora (Execução e Precisão) :

Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.

Garantir precisão absoluta "batendo" dados e regras manualmente; em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.

Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.

  • O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura) :

Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais.

Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.

Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios, utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.

Curiosidade Investigativa : Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.

Atitude e Senso de Urgência : Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.

Mão no Código : Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).

Legado : você deixará o seu nome na construção, nos códigos e na história da empresa.

Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial : Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.

Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível : Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.

Company Description

Upstream Capital is a tactical investor focused on growth‑stage technology companies, deploying both debt and equity to scale businesses. Headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, the firm has a global reach, with a proven track record of investing over $200 million in over 25 tech companies across Latin America, the Bay Area, and other regions. With deep expertise in the tech sector, Upstream Capital operates as a comprehensive finance platform leveraging knowledge, networking, data, and AI to drive success. The company is committed to partnering with innovative businesses, finding creative solutions to complex challenges, and aligning success between investors and investees for long‑term growth.

Role Description

The role is designed for someone who is deeply curious about how companies operate, how their economics work, and what are the patterns that make some of them thrive. The Intern will be exposed to the full investment process and encouraged to think critically about markets and capital allocation.

Beyond analytical work, we value people who enjoy engaging with the broader investment landscape. The role involves listening, asking good questions, forming independent views, and contributing ideas to internal discussions. Curiosity and judgment matter as much as technical skills.

Upstream operates in a lean, high‑ownership environment. Interns are expected to take responsibility for their work, explore opportunities proactively, and learn by doing. We look for individuals who are comfortable navigating ambiguity and who see feedback and mistakes as part of the learning process.

Candidates may come from any academic background. What matters is intellectual rigor, attention to detail, and a consistent pattern of high personal standards. Prior exposure to finance, consulting, or technology is a plus, but not a prerequisite.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in financial modeling and deep understanding of finance principles
  • Ability to communicate insights effectively through reports and presentations
  • Experience in, or knowledge of, the technology sector is a plus
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is strongly preferred
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business administration, or a related field

About Us

Formerly known as Upload Ventures Growth, Upstream has the goal of becoming a platform for lifecycle investing in growth and late‑stage technology companies. The firm builds on Upload's track record of supporting global founders and leverages its experience in venture capital, technology, and data to identify, underwrite, and scale high‑performing businesses.

Upstream operates with a lean structure and a hands‑on approach. We value analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to execute with precision in fast‑paced environments.

title: Domain Architect Networking
description:
We are looking for a Domain Architect Networking, who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid, in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.

Job Description

The Domain Architect – Networking will play an essential role in the design, governance and evolution of the network architectures that support the digital, industrial and corporate operations of Brasil and Canada. He will be responsible for the strategic planning, specification, integration and optimization of corporate communication platforms: SD-WAN, LAN/WAN, OT/IT industrial networks, Wi‑Fi, underground networks, data centers, cloud integration, 5G, satellite and edge for mining.

Its mission is to ensure robustness, availability, performance, security, and scalability – enabling automation, digitalization, advanced analytics, industrial IoT, and support for key critical environments. He will work directly with global IT, Operations, Security, and Engineering teams, supporting a multicultural and multifunctional environment.

Main Responsibilities

Lead the design, documentation and evolution of enterprise, industrial and mission‑critical network architectures for global, underground, remote, mobile/IoT and cloud/hybrid operations.

Specify patterns, high and low complexity diagrams (logical view, physical, topology, VLAN, routing, SDN), considering redundancy, availability, performance, and resiliency.

Evaluate, select and supervise deployment of emerging technologies: SD‑WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, private 5G, mesh networks, VPNs, segmentation of OT/IT networks in a mining environment.

Define and ensure compliance with global security standards (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), encryption policies, access control, vulnerability mitigation, and incident response.

Lead network integration projects between Brazil, Canada, industrial areas/mines, offices, plants and data centers, enabling high connectivity, performance and security.

Orchestrate processes of technological update, equipment replacement, configuration automation and network monitoring, including SRE, observability, Service Mesh.

Create and maintain detailed documentation: diagrams, flows, contingency plans, playbooks, usage policies, governance, and technical templates.

Direct interface with Engineering, Operations, Security, DevOps, Industrial Automation teams, global architecture teams and strategic suppliers.

Monitor, optimize and evolve the communication infrastructure, aiming at maximum efficiency, IoT support, industrial analytics, autonomous mine operation and compliance.

Support the development of strategic projects (mining 4.0, edge computing, digital twins, cloud/industrial integration, ESG) and train internal teams.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

Bachelor's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or related.

Minimum of 8 years of solid experience as a network architect, working in critical industrial, enterprise/global, multinational and mining/resources environments.

Mastery of the main protocols, architectures and standards: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi‑Fi, SD‑WAN, 5G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, OT/IT Convergence.

Real experience with Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD‑WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens industrial solutions, cloud networking platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).

Practical interface with complex environments: underground/mining, industrial networks, industrial environments 4.0, cloud integration, high availability, disaster recovery.

Experience in network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), advanced monitoring (SNMP, NetFlow, SRE Observability).

Excellence in documentation, technical design, governance support, multi‑platform integration and international performance with remote teams.

Soft Skills

Technical leadership, positive influence, consultative action and consensus building between teams and global cultures.

Strategic and analytical ability to plan, execute, and evolve complex, highly available architectures.

Clear and assertive communication with stakeholders at all levels, internationally distributed teams.

Proactivity, resilience, focus on solutions, adaptability and collaborative posture.

Absolute focus on results – operational, safety, innovation and support of infrastructure.

Differentials / Nice to Have

Experience in greenfield/brownfield projects, integration of industrial networks/IoT, edge/mesh/satellite, mine digitalization.

Experience with underground networks, mining‑specific wireless solutions, industrial OT/IT environments, SRE/observability on a global scale.

Participation in technical forums, publications, international events, benchmarks, leadership in strategic projects from large mining companies.

Ability to work in different time zones, multi‑site environments and multicultural teams.

Robust and secure reference architecture for all Brazil and Canada network environments, including integration, automation, performance and high availability.

Execution of strategic projects for technological evolution, digitalization, automation, analytics and ESG, supporting business results.

Dissemination of best practices, technical painting of the teams involved, development of governance policies and global operation.

Active performance in innovation, benchmarking and implementation of new technologies that support the group's digital and operational transformation.

Ensuring compliance, operational resilience, risk mitigation and increasing efficiency for operations.

Additional Comments

This professional will be a protagonist in the transformation and support of corporate, industrial and critical network architecture, enabling the global Brazil‑Canada operation and the group's digital/ESG evolution.

Our client is a global investment and operating group focused on acquiring and growing technology-driven businesses. With a long-term ownership approach, the organization partners with companies to support sustainable growth, operational excellence, and value creation over time.

The group operates through a decentralized model, bringing together a diverse set of businesses across multiple geographies and industries. Each company retains a high degree of autonomy, while benefiting from shared expertise, strategic guidance, and disciplined capital allocation.

In Brazil, the organization is experiencing a strong growth phase, driven by ongoing acquisitions. This expansion brings both opportunity and complexity, particularly in strengthening leadership capabilities and ensuring consistent performance across independently operated businesses.

Purpose of the Position

As the organization continues to expand through acquisitions, this role has been created to strengthen leadership capability and talent scalability across its businesses. Operating at the intersection of growth and integration, the position focuses on shaping and advancing a talent strategy that supports long-term performance, leadership continuity, and organizational resilience.

Based in Brazil, the role will initially support the local group of businesses, while being designed with a broader, multi-entity mandate and the potential to expand across Latin America over time.

This is a highly strategic position centered on designing and evolving talent architecture across multiple business units, rather than focusing on the execution of established HR programs within a single organization. Working within a decentralized and lean environment, the individual will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing key decisions related to leadership, succession, and organizational effectiveness.

Impact will be driven through influence, coaching, and the ability to leverage existing HR and business resources, rather than through a large, dedicated team. Over time, success will be reflected in stronger leadership pipelines, scalable succession frameworks, and a measurable reduction of leadership risk, particularly in post-acquisition environments.

The Candidate

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Build and embed scalable talent frameworks across a diverse and growing group of businesses
  • Address leadership gaps following ownership transitions, ensuring continuity and long-term readiness
  • Influence senior stakeholders across decentralized business units
  • Support sustained growth by aligning talent strategy with ongoing expansion
  • Assess and integrate leadership and talent in newly acquired companies
  • Implement data-driven approaches to talent and workforce decisions
  • Deliver impact in a lean, influence-based operating model
  • The role does not oversee daily HR operations or business unit-level execution

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in HR, talent strategy, and / or business leadership roles
  • Proven experience designing and scaling talent strategy across complex environments
  • Exposure to multi-business or matrix structures
  • Strong experience influencing senior stakeholders (C-level / business leaders)
  • Background in high-growth, transformation, or M&A-driven environments
  • Experience with due diligence and integration from a people perspective
  • Data-driven mindset with experience leveraging workforce insights
  • International exposure and cross-cultural experience
  • Experience beyond traditional HR expected, exposure to enterprise-level talent strategies
  • Background that includes enterprise-level or strategic talent initiatives
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree is a plus
  • Fluent English required; Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus

Behavioral Skills

  • Strategic and business-oriented mindset
  • Strong executive influence and stakeholder management
  • Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity
  • Focus on building scalable solutions
  • Ability to drive results through influence

Additional Information

No direct team initially; impact is driven through influence and leverage of existing resources

Brazil-based role with potential expansion into a broader regional scope

We're hiring a mid‑level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM‑powered features. This isn't a research project. title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real‑world, high‑stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real‑world, high‑stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

  • Análise Técnica de Prescrição: Validar a dose prescrita cruzando dados laboratoriais e medidas antropométricas;
  • Identificar e gerenciar medicamentos de uso contínuo que o paciente utiliza, evitando interações medicamentosas com o protocolo quimioterápico;

  • Preparação de Antineoplásicos: Manipular quimioterápicos em Cabines de Segurança Biológica;

  • Cadastro: Atuar em revisões de cadastros, itens de prescrição e manual farmacoterapêutico, a fim de atualizar indicação, posologia, incompatibilidades medicamentosas e interações medicamentosas;
  • Padronização: Revisar padronização da unidade periodicamente e sugerir itens com melhor custo-benefício, considerando qualidade, efetividade e segurança;
  • Monitorar as atividades dos auxiliares de suprimentos;
  • Supervisar e realizar inventários periódicos;
  • Compreender e acompanhar os indicadores, resultados e melhoria contínua juntamente com a liderança;

  • Liderar e orientar as atividades de inspeção prevendo os recursos necessários, cumprindo as normativas legais, de segurança e de engenharia, a fim de cumprir com o plano de manutenção, metas estabelecidas e garantir a máxima disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos ativos;
  • Executar e/ou orientar a equipe para a realização das atividades diárias de manutenções preditivas, preventivas e corretivas nas linhas de transmissão energizadas e/ou desenergizadas, prevendo os recursos necessários, cumprindo as normativas legais, de segurança e de engenharia, a fim de cumprir com o plano de manutenção, metas estabelecidas e garantir a máxima disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos ativos;
  • Responder pela execução das manutenções especializadas em linhas energizadas, cumprindo com os procedimentos da Engenharia e requisitos estabelecidos pela Segurança do Trabalho, com objetivo de manter a disponibilidade e confiabilidade da LT e cumprindo com o plano de manutenção;
  • Realizar o atendimento às situações emergenciais e urgências, executando inspeções especiais, localizando e identificando as causas de desligamentos automáticos, a fim de esclarecer os eventos e reestabelecer a função de transmissão no menor prazo possível;
  • Contribuir na conservação e manutenção das instalações e subsedes, reportando ao supervisor o controle de datas de vencimento/pagamento de taxas referentes a consumos, impostos e seguros, garantindo as boas condições de infraestrutura para o adequado desenvolvimento das atividades;
  • Recepcionar e acompanhar visitas e auditorias de órgãos externos, conforme orientação do superior imediato, atendendo as demandas e apresentando documentos, a fim de demonstrar que os requisitos legais estão sendo cumpridos conforme as normativas estabelecidas;
  • Auxiliar o supervisor na administração Adm/Financeira/Contábil local (caixa), cumprindo com os procedimentos administrativos financeiros, contribuindo para a emissão de relatórios de entradas e saídas, com suporte em notas fiscais, a fim de cumprir com os procedimentos administrativos financeiros;
  • Manter o software de gerenciamento da manutenção atualizado com informações resultantes das inspeções realizadas, com objetivo de relatar/controlar o cumprimento das atividades de manutenção, mantendo os indicadores de manutenção atualizados;
  • Fornecer informações técnicas decorrentes de falhas e de desempenho de equipamentos e sistemas, relatando informações específicas, a fim de subsidiar a análise dos especialistas da área de Engenharia;
  • Zelar pelo bom uso e conservação das ferramentas e instrumentos de manutenção de linha de transmissão, com objetivo de manter a segurança e o patrimônio da empresa;
  • Estabelecer contato rotineiro com os proprietários de terras por onde passam as linhas de transmissão, identificando e reportando ao supervisor pontos de insatisfação, a fim de manter um bom relacionamento e garantir o livre acesso para a realização dos serviços;
  • Elaborar os relatórios de inspeções técnicas, seguindo os padrões pré-estabelecidos pela engenharia, a fim de cumprir os requisitos legais do contrato vigente;
  • Acompanhar e/ou executar o comissionamento e recepção de novos equipamentos e linhas de transmissão, cumprindo com o plano de comissionamento e do projeto executivo, a fim de obter a liberação para entrada em operação comercial;
  • Auxiliar a equipe de SE no desenvolvimento de atividades preditivas, preventivas e corretivas, a fim de atender o plano de manutenção e metas estabelecidas;
  • Conduzir os veículos da empresa cumprindo a legislação de trânsito e política de frotas, zelando pela segurança, pelo ativo e imagem da COTESA e do cliente;
  • Realizar o recebimento de materiais e equipamentos, controlando, organizando, limpando e mantendo a boa conservação dos sobressalentes, cumprindo os procedimentos estabelecidos, sugerindo melhorias nas condições de armazenamento, objetivando manter os estoques em melhores condições de utilização;
  • Cumprir e orientar a equipe no cumprimento das normativas legais e procedimentos internos, mantendo atualizada a documentação de segurança, fiscalizando a correta utilização e conservação dos EPIs e EPC, atuando preventivamente no monitoramento das atividades, identificando situações de risco, propondo ao SESMT medidas de controle, a fim de zelar pelas questões de saúde e segurança;
  • Zelar pelo bom relacionamento com a equipe local do cliente, a fim de compatibilizar as demandas de serviços decorrentes de solicitações do mesmo e as demandas próprias;
  • Cumprir com as questões ambientais, supervisionando e orientando sua equipe de trabalho, a fim de atender a legislação e programas ambientais vigentes oriundos do licenciamento do empreendimento;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração e execução dos Planos de Contingência e/ou Planos de Atendimento a Emergências e/ou Planos de Segurança em Barragens, seguindo os procedimentos internos, identificando os desvios e implementando as ações necessárias para o cumprimento, dimensionando os recursos necessários, a fim de garantir a operacionalidade e segurança das pessoas e instalações;
  • Contribuir para a elaboração de especificações técnicas, seguindo procedimentos internos, a fim de realizar a contratação de serviços especializados;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento dos indicadores da área, identificando fragilidades e distorções, sugerindo ações e auxiliando o supervisor na implementação de ações corretivas, a fim de obter melhores resultados nos processos da área e subsidiar a tomada de decisão em nível estratégico;
  • Contribuir com o desenvolvimento dos demais colegas da equipe, orientando a execução das atividades e compartilhando conhecimentos, reportando ao supervisor dificuldades e necessidades de treinamento, a fim de contribuir para a capacitação da equipe;
  • Prestar atendimento e realizar outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao cargo exercido, conforme orientação e/ou solicitação do superior imediato.

Estamos em processo de implantação da ISO 9001, com foco em padronização de processos, melhoria contínua e eficiência operacional, uma excelente oportunidade para o profissional participar ativamente da estruturação e evolução do escritório .

hospitalares (TASY, MV ou similares).

Elaborar e manter controles de monitoramento dos custos por setor, por produção e por serviços.

Acompanhar indicadores econômico-assistenciais, incluindo custo por paciente, custo por setor, custo por procedimento.

Suportar auditorias internas e externas, apresentando evidências e justificativas das variações de custo.

Construir relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e análises críticas para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Atuar em parceria com áreas assistenciais, suprimentos, faturamento e contabilidade para obter informações e alinhar critérios de custeio.

Participar da revisão e otimização dos processos de custeio e do fluxo da prestação de contas.

Participar do ciclo orçamentário anual e mensal, consolidando dados, monitorando desvios (real vs. orçado) e propondo ações corretivas.

Apoiar a análise do impacto financeiro dos repasses médicos, verificando conformidade com contratos e identificando oportunidades

de otimização.

Contribuir para estudos de viabilidade econômica de novos serviços, tecnologias ou expansões, incluindo propostas de precificação para procedimentos particulares.

Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados extraídos dos sistemas ERP, colaborando com as equipes de cadastro e parametrização.

Identificar desperdícios operacionais e propor melhorias em processos.

Cumprir o regulamento interno, os requisitos dos sistemas de gestão da qualidade, observação e cumprimento das regulamentações da ANS, bem como das normas e procedimentos de saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho inerentes ao setor, a utilização de EPI´s/ EPEC`s (Equipamento de proteção individual/ Equipamento de proteção coletivo) quando a atividade assim o exigir.

title: Supervisor de limpeza de asg
description:
SUPERVISOR(A) DE LIMPEZA E CONSERVAÇÃO (ASG)RESUMO DO CARGO

Coordenar e liderar a equipe de 20 auxiliares de serviços gerais em condomínio de grande porte, garantindo a excelência na manutenção e conservação de todas as áreas. O foco principal é a gestão de pessoas, elaboração de escalas, controle rigoroso de estoque e padronização dos processos de limpeza. O supervisor deve atuar como o elo entre a equipe operacional e a administração/síndico, assegurando que as metas de higiene e os cronogramas de manutenção preventiva sejam rigorosamente cumpridos.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Liderar, treinar e motivar a equipe de 20 colaboradores (ASGs).

  • Elaborar e gerir escalas de trabalho, folgas e substituições.

  • Realizar rondas técnicas diárias para controle de qualidade (Checklists).

  • Gerenciar o estoque de materiais de limpeza e insumos, evitando desperdícios e rupturas.

  • Elaborar cronogramas de limpeza pesada (lavagem de fachadas, garagens, quadras).

  • Garantir o uso correto e obrigatório de EPIs, zelando pelas normas de segurança (NR 01 e NR 06).

  • Avaliar o desempenho individual da equipe e realizar feedbacks constantes.

  • Realizar a integração de novos colaboradores e treinamentos técnicos.

  • Monitorar o estado de conservação de equipamentos (enceradeiras, lavadoras, carrinhos).

  • Atender solicitações críticas de moradores e administrar conflitos internos.

QUALIFICAÇÕES

Competências de informática * Pacote Office (Excel para controle de estoque e Word para relatórios).

  • Uso fluído de ferramentas de comunicação (WhatsApp Business / Grupos de equipe).

  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão operacional ou ERP Condominial (Desejável).

Competências profissionais * Liderança assertiva e gestão de grandes equipes.

  • Profundo conhecimento em diluição química e técnicas de limpeza profissional.

  • Habilidade em planejamento estratégico de manutenção (POP - Procedimento Operacional Padrão).

  • Visão crítica para identificação de riscos ocupacionais e ambientais.

  • Excelente comunicação e postura para lidar com a alta gestão e moradores.

  • Capacidade de organização e gestão de tempo sob pressão.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

  • Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório).

  • Ensino Superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas afins (Desejável).

  • Curso técnico em Segurança do Trabalho ou Gestão de Pessoas (Diferencial).

EXPERIÊNCIA DESEJÁVEL

  • Experiência comprovada em supervisão de limpeza em condomínios de luxo, shoppings ou grandes indústrias.

  • Histórico de gestão de equipes com mais de 10 pessoas.

  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança e saúde no trabalho.

REQUISITOS

  • Disponibilidade de horário e para eventuais emergências aos finais de semana.

  • Perfil proativo com foco em resolução de problemas e humanização da equipe.

REGIME DE CONTRATAÇÃO

Prazer, nós somos GRUPO LOS!

No Grupo LOS, consolidamos uma trajetória sólida na logística, com mais de 60 anos de experiência desde a nossa fundação em 1959. Com presença nacional, contamos com mais de 60 unidades de norte a sul do país e uma equipe comprometida de mais de 1000 colaboradores, sendo reconhecidos como referência em soluções logísticas. Unimos nosso conhecimento ao compromisso de proporcionar serviços integrados com agilidade, segurança e foco em resultados em todas as nossas operações, oferecendo uma gama diversificada de soluções personalizadas para atender às necessidades específicas dos nossos clientes. Essa abrangência nos permite oferecer serviços logísticos de alta qualidade em todo o território nacional, conectando pessoas, empresas e mercados.

O QUE BUSCAMOS?

Buscamos um profissional para atuar como Assistente de Logística Sênior em nossa unidade localizada em Salvador/BA. 

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:

Gestão e atualização das tabelas de frete (transportadora, terceiros e agregados);

Conferência de processos pendentes, enviados e negados;

Realizar lançamento de conhecimentos (CTE) não normais solicitado pelas filiais (diárias, complementar, substituição, anulação) de notas recebidas por email da operação para realizar as emissões e envio de CT-e NFs/ MDF-e + Contrato de frete;

Atender solicitação de cancelamento de CTE, MDFE, contrato de frete CF e nota fiscal de serviço NFS;

Alimenta planilha interna de controla das intercorrências de todos os clientes internos e externos;

Controle de planilha as DT s e o XML dos clientes;

Realiza abertura de chamado no gerenciamento de email;

Relatório de análise de indicadores para verificar a produtividade da equipe, tanto da tratativa dos email quanto GW;

Aprovar margem para financeiro realizar deposito em conta;

Participar de reuniões com financeiro, torre de controle para entender necessidades e realizar tratativas;

Ser o multiplicador em novos processos de aprendizagem e novas operações;

Participar de ações de treinamento da empresa;

Cumprir políticas e procedimentos da empresa;

Tratativa com motoristas;

Solicitação de destinos aos motoristas;

Dar suporte a gestão do setor;

Gestão de resultado.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

Ensino médio completo

Experiência prévia na área de logística

Habilidade em análise e solução de problemas

Pacote Office

INFORMAÇÕES DO CARGO:

Salário: R$ 2.253,83

Regime de contratação: Efetivo (CLT)

Jornada de Trabalho: 44 semanais

Benefícios:

Vale alimentação (Cartão Caju)

Vale transporte (Cartão Caju)

Plano de Saúde (Unimed)

Plano Odontologico (Bradesco)

Ficou interessado na vaga!? Vem fazer parte do nosso time, #VemSerLOS

Se você procura fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica, comprometida com a excelência é reconhecida como um ótimo lugar para se trabalhar, o Grupo LOS é o seu destino. Junte-se a nós e faça parte do futuro da logística, onde cada colaborador contribui para a nossa missão de conectar o mundo de forma eficiente e inovadora.

title: Analista de projetos de engenharia
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em acompanhamento de obras e projetos de engenharia, com perfil proativo e capacidade de liderança. Espera-se que atue com autonomia, antecipe problemas e entregue resultados com responsabilidade técnica.
O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir o planejamento, controle e execução de projetos de infraestrutura e obras nas unidades da empresa, atuando de forma integrada com as equipes técnicas e de gestão.Perfil comportamental

Valorizamos profissionais que assumem protagonismo, antecipam problemas, engajam equipes e entregam resultados com qualidade e responsabilidade.

Se você busca desafios e tem orgulho do trabalho bem feito, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Elaborar e gerenciar cronogramas físico-financeiros, definindo prazos, marcos e entregas;
  • Monitorar o progresso físico e financeiro dos projetos, propondo ajustes quando necessário;
  • Controlar custos e promover melhoria contínua dos processos;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente na elaboração de escopos, análise de projetos e definição de materiais;
  • Identificar gargalos e ineficiências, propondo soluções e estruturando processos (LPU, LPP);
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos e conduzir processos de contratação;
  • Acompanhar a execução de obras, garantindo conformidade com projetos e padrões técnicos.
Requisitos
  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em obras e projetos de engenharia;
  • Domínio de MS Project, Power BI e Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua (Six Sigma, PDCA, DMAIC);
  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança do trabalho;
  • Disponibilidade para visitas técnicas e deslocamentos.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com terraplanagem, pavimentação ou obras industriais/portuárias;
  • Conhecimento em AutoCAD;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão (Smartsheet, ClickUp, Monday.com);
  • Experiência com memoriais descritivos e contratações técnicas;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA na área.
Benefícios
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamentos

  • Diferencial ter conhecimento intermediário no Excel.

title: Consultor(a) de vendas de veículos - salvador/ba
description:
Se você:


  • Possui o ensino médio Completo;
  • Possui CNH categoria B;
  • Noções de Informática e em Sistemas de Gestão de Vendas e CRM;
  • Tem experiência com atendimento ao cliente;
  • Tem conhecimento em Matemática Financeira;
  • Tem conhecimento em técnica de vendas e negociação.


O #GrupoNewChase é o seu lugar!


Será considerado um diferencial se você:


  • Tem experiência comercial em concessionárias;
  • Realizar atendimento ao cliente seja no showroom ou no digital/ligação, aplicando a metodologia padrão da montadora, através de uma postura simpática, entusiasmada e cordial com conhecimentos sedimentados dos produtos, identificando as necessidades do cliente e apresentando o mix de produtos e benefícios com o objetivo de garantir o fechamento do negócio e atingir as metas estabelecidas pela Diretoria Comercial.
  •  Realizar vendas mensais, equilibrando volume, ISC (Índice de Satisfação do Cliente), lucratividade, acessórios, F&I e serviços, buscando atingir os objetivos do Grupo e os individuais.
  • Identificar as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções adequadas, realizando demonstrações de veículos e test drive, negociando condições de pagamento, preços e prazo de entrega, com isso concretizando a venda e o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela Diretoria da área.  
  • Realizar prospecção de novos clientes através de ferramentas digitais e/ou ligações, utilizando redes sociais, e-mails marketing e outras plataformas online para alcançar potenciais clientes e realizando chamadas ativas para leads qualificados, proporcionando um atendimento personalizado e consultivo.  
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado automotivo e características dos produtos oferecidos, para ser capaz de oferecer as melhores soluções de mobilidade, incluindo uma abordagem proativa na prospecção de novos clientes, através de ferramentas digitais e a prospecção por ligação.  
  • Acompanhar e controlar, diariamente, a sua agenda, através do sistema corporativo de gestão de relacionamento com cliente. 
  • Monitorar o funil de vendas, acompanhando todas as etapas do processo de venda, desde a prospecção inicial até o fechamento. 
  • Analisar os dados do funil de vendas para identificar gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria, ajustando estratégias conforme necessário, segmentando os clientes de acordo com o estágio no funil de vendas, personalizando abordagens e comunicações para maximizar as chances de conversão. 
  • Registrar, diariamente, no sistema corporativo todo histórico dos atendimentos realizados (telefone, e-mail, showroom, recepção, qualificação, apresentação do veículo, test drive, negociação, entrega, gestão de carteira e vendas que não foram efetuadas) com motivos e acompanhamentos, a fim de manter atualização e criar dados para análise de melhorias futuras.
  • Elaborar a proposta de venda, através do sistema corporativo, certificando que o produto esteja em estoque, trânsito e plano mensal, seguindo as orientações internas do departamento, visando fornecer ao cliente informações verídicas da negociação, promovendo sua satisfação e garantindo o resultado esperado pelo setor. 
  • Acompanhar todo o processo da venda (emplacamento, instalação de acessórios, processo de veículo usado quando se aplicar), monitorando os pagamentos efetuados pelos clientes, para garantir o prazo de entrega negociado e preservar total satisfação do cliente. 
  • Inserir todas as propostas e documentos do processo de vendas no sistema de arquivo digital corporativo, contribuindo para o funcionamento correto do departamento, considerando políticas internas do Grupo. 
  • Acompanhar a entrega dos veículos vendidos, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
  • Representar a concessionária do Grupo NewChase em feiras, eventos e lançamentos de novos produtos, promovendo os veículos e serviços da marca.
  • Monitorar as tendências do mercado automotivo, novas tecnologias e atividades da concorrência, identificando oportunidades de negócio e sugerindo ações para aumentar a competitividade do setor.
  • Realizar os cursos presenciais e via WEB da montadora e do Grupo, através do cronograma de cursos enviado pela Diretoria de Recursos Humanos, a fim de garantir a aprovação e manutenção do índice definido pela montadora.
  • Executar outras tarefas que venham a ser delegadas pelo(a) gestor(a) da área.

  • Possuir experiência com Atendimento ao Cliente e Vendas.
  • Realizar inspeção inicial dos veículos novos que chegam à concessionária, para verificar a integridade e conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos e registrar e relatar quaisquer danos ou discrepâncias encontradas durante a inspeção;
  • Controlar o cumprimento dos prazos de cada etapa de preparação, direcionando todo o fluxo entre a preparação até a disponibilidade do veículo para a entrega, garantido o cumprimento de todas as etapas, priorizando as instalações que demandam mais tempo, visando cumprir ou antecipar os prazos de entrega dos carros aos clientes;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos serviços limpeza dos veículos e de instalação de acessórios e reparo de pequenas avarias quando necessário, a fim de garantir que o carro seja entregue no prazo para o cliente;
  • Movimentar os veículos entre os departamentos e, quando necessário, de um pátio para o outro, a fim de proporcionar o andamento dos processos de preparação;
  • Identificar os veículos que serão preparados para entrega no dia e verificar a qualidade do serviço de instalação de acessórios e pequenos reparos, utilizando check-list padrão e realizando testes dos elementos eletroeletrônicos, a fim de garantir o funcionamento de todos os componentes e a estética do veículo de acordo com os critérios da montadora e do Grupo;
  • Realizar a entrega técnica do veículo, explicando ao cliente as funcionalidades, comandos, sistemas e tecnologias embarcadas;
  • Orientar sobre os manuais, garantias, revisão programada, bem como procedimentos de manutenção e uso seguro do veículo.

title: Promotor de vendas motoboy
description:
Descrição Sumária Motoboy Comercial (Tirador de Pedido de Óleo)

Responsável por realizar visitas diárias a clientes e potenciais geradores de óleo, tirando pedidos de forma presencial, coletando informações comerciais e repassando os dados ao sistema da empresa. Participa das reuniões matinais e de fechamento do dia, garantindo o alinhamento das metas e o acompanhamento das entregas. Atua com foco em prospecção, relacionamento e fidelização de clientes, mantendo a imagem da empresa com profissionalismo, pontualidade e boa comunicação.

ROTINA E ATIVIDADES DO MOTOBOY COMERCIAL Rotina Diária

  1. Reunião Matinal (Call) 7h40

    • Alinhamento rápido com o time (roteiro do dia, metas, clientes prioritários).

    • Atualização de pendências do dia anterior.

    • Motivação e foco: bater pedido é missão!

  2. Roteirização das Visitas

    • Planejar o trajeto do dia (usando mapa, WhatsApp e histórico de clientes).

    • Confirmar com clientes o melhor horário para visita.

  3. Prospecção e Tirada de Pedidos

    • Abordar novos geradores e clientes (usinas, fábricas, oficinas, etc.).

    • Apresentar produto e benefícios da Gran Oil.

    • Tirar o pedido direto via celular (app ou formulário padrão).

    • Coletar dados: nome do cliente, CNPJ, telefone, endereço, tipo e quantidade de óleo.

  4. Envio de Informações para o Sistema (via Sólides ou outro CRM)

    • Registrar no sistema todos os pedidos do dia.

    • Atualizar status de visita: novo cliente, em negociação, pedido fechado, pendente.

    • Enviar fotos ou comprovantes, se necessário.

  5. Follow-up e Retorno

    • Fazer ligações de acompanhamento com clientes antigos.

    • Verificar se entregas e coletas foram concluídas corretamente.

  6. Reunião de Fechamento (Call final do dia)

    • Resumo das visitas realizadas.

    • Pedidos fechados e oportunidades perdidas.

    • Compartilhar informações relevantes com o time comercial.

Rotina Semanal

  1. Reunião Presencial (1x por semana)

    • Alinhamento geral com o gestor e equipe.

    • Análise dos resultados da semana (litros vendidos, novos clientes, taxa de conversão).

    • Treinamento rápido sobre produto, abordagem e metas da próxima semana.

  2. Atualização do CRM

    • Revisar e corrigir dados de clientes e pedidos.

    • Enviar relatórios de rota, performance e feedbacks de campo.

Responsabilidades Gerais

  • Manter moto e uniforme em bom estado (apresentação conta ponto!).

  • Cumprir metas diárias e semanais de visita e pedido.

  • Responder mensagens e chamadas comerciais durante o expediente.

  • Zelar pela boa imagem da Gran Oil sorriso e postura de confiança!

title: Analista de controle de investimentos
description:
Missão do Cargo: 

Assegurar o acompanhamento e qualidade das informações dos investimentos financeiros e imobiliários, contribuindo para a tomada de decisão, a conformidade regulatória, a governança e a geração de valor sustentável para a entidade.

Responsabilidade e Tarefas: 

  • Executar o acompanhamento, controle e análise das carteiras de investimentos, assegurando a consistência das informações econômico-financeiras.

  • Efetuar conciliações de posições, fluxos financeiros e rentabilidades entre sistemas internos, custodiante, administradores e gestores de recursos.
  • Acompanhar indicadores macroeconômicos e financeiro impactam a carteira de investimentos dos planos e perfis.
  • Realizar o controle, acompanhamento e atualização das informações relativas aos imóveis próprios e investimentos imobiliários.
  • Acompanhar contratos imobiliários (locação, cessão, notas fiscais, compra e venda), analisando prazos, reajustes e riscos associados.
  • Apoiar a análise de laudos de avaliação imobiliária, estudos de viabilidade e documentos técnicos relacionados aos ativos.
  • Consolidar e analisar informações sobre receitas e despesas imobiliárias, taxas de ocupação, rentabilidade e desempenho econômico dos imóveis.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de informações e relatórios destinados à Diretoria, Conselhos, Comitês de Investimentos e órgãos reguladores.
  • Atuar no suporte a auditorias internas e externas, organizando informações, documentos e evidências dos processos sob responsabilidade da Gerência.
  • Propor melhorias em rotinas operacionais, automatizações e padronizações de controles e relatórios.
  • Realizar outras atividades que tenham relação com o cargo.

Formação: 

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade e áreas afins. 
    Aceitável: Cursando ultimo semestre.

Experiência:

  •  Recém formado e/ou experiência de pelo menos 1 ano na área ou função similar.

  • Conhecimentos avançados de informática (Pacote Office).

Competências:

  • Cumprimento a Métodos e Processos Operacionais;
  • Matemática Financeira;
  • Controle e análise de informações;
  • Elaboração e análise de relatórios;
  • Bom domínio de Excel e planilhas gerenciais (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, controles);
